defs.def: a fully grown person who is legally responsible for their actions （法律上指能为自己的行为负责的）成年人

ex.s: Being an adult is about having a rooted sense of self while being capable of identifying and managing your emotions and actions. ____38____ We are a social species, so this is important.
ex.t: 成为成年人，意味着拥有扎实的自我感，同时能够识别并管理自己的情绪和行为。____38____ 我们是社会性物种，所以这一点很重要。

ex.s: Angelou is best known for her series of seven autobiographies, which focus on her childhood and early adult experiences.
ex.t: 安杰卢以她的七部自传系列最为知名，这些自传聚焦于她的童年和成年早期经历。

ex.s: Bring...up: to look after a child until he/ she becomes an adult eg She brought up three sons.
ex.t: Bring...up：抚养孩子直到他/她长大成人，例如她抚养了三个儿子。

ex.s: Although the 300 kg adult males can look a bit scary - don’t worry, they’re harmless!
ex.t: 虽然300公斤重的成年雄性看起来有点吓人——别担心，它们无害！

defs.def: a fully grown animal 成年动物

Societies all over the world view the concept of an adult as self-supporting and self-directed, because it identifies a point in the life cycle.
ex.t: 全世界的社会的都把“成年人”这一概念视为能够自立和自主，因为它标示了生命周期中的一个节点。

ex.s: So, being an adult isn’t just holding a job.
ex.t: 所以，成为成年人不仅仅是有一份工作。

ex.s: More importantly, it is also about releasing children into the world with a life skill they’ll need as an adult when they’re no longer in their parents’ care.
ex.t: 更重要的是，这也是让孩子们带着一项生活技能走向世界，这项技能在他们长大、不再受父母照顾时会用得上。

ex.t: 成年蜜蜂____54____并在齐亚德逃离树时不断攻击。

ex.s: Failure to provide enough chaperones will result in an extra charge of $50 per absent adult.
ex.t: 若未提供足够的监护人，每位缺席的成人将额外收取50美元。

ex.s: Children under 12 years accompanied by an adult are admitted free.
ex.t: 12岁以下由成人陪同的儿童免费入场。

ex.t: 然后我们问那个孩子能否____29____或听到那个成年人。

ex.t: 当成年人捂住自己的嘴时，同样的____30____发生了：____31____孩子说他们无法____32____和她交流。

ex.s: Some people live with their elderly parents; many more adult children are returning to the family home, if they ever left.
ex.t: 有些人和年迈父母同住；更多的人——如果曾经离开过——又回到了家里。

ex.s: C．learn about the adult community
ex.t: C．了解成人社区

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．
ex.t: 你愿意为这个人的未来下注吗？他53岁。他成年后的大部分时间都在与债务和不幸的失败抗争中。战争伤病让他的左手失去功能，他还常进监狱。在不知从何而来的动机驱使下，他决定写一本书。

ex.s: A．To provide guidance on leading a meaningful adult life．
ex.t: A．为过有意义的成人生活提供指引。

ex.s: “Even in families whose parents didn't have a college education... families are smaller, and the idea that children need to be carefully ___53___ has really sunk in.” The ___54___ of “adult activities” could not be attributed to more homework or extracurricular activities, the study said, noting that teens today spend fewer hours on homework and the same amount of time on extracurricular as they did in the 1990s ( with the exception of community service, which has risen slightly).
ex.t: “即使在父母没有大学学历的家庭……家庭规模更小，孩子需要被细心___53___的观念已真正深入人心。”研究称，“成人活动”的___54___不能归因于更多的家庭作业或课外活动，并指出如今青少年花在家庭作业上的时间更少，课外活动时间与1990年代相同（除社区服务略有上升外）。

behaving in an intelligent and responsible way; typical of what is expected of an adult （智力、思想、行为）成熟的，成人的

ex.s: The problem isn't just screens ___24___, but also the way screens tempt kids (and adults) away from something far more important: physical activity.
ex.t: 问题不只是屏幕____，还在于屏幕诱惑孩子（和大人）远离更重要的事：身体活动。

defs.def: intended for adults only, because it is about sex or contains violence 仅限成人的（因有色情或暴力内容）

ex.s: Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers’ bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.
ex.t: 被称为激素的身体化学物质水平的变化，不仅让青少年身体发育出成人特征，还让他们在晚上11点前难以入睡。

ex.s: “This productivity also translates into the workplace for adults.
ex.t: “这种生产力也转化为成年人在职场上的表现。”

ex.s: Hoping to find a hobby that can be shared by both the little ones and adults? ___36___ You may know the “feel-good” emotions that come with helping others, but there are even more unexpected ways volunteering will positively affect the whole family.
ex.t: 希望能找到一个老少皆宜的共同爱好？___36____ 你可能知道帮助他人带来的“感觉良好”情绪，但志愿服务以更出人意料的方式对整个家庭产生积极影响。

ex.s: For adults, volunteering can provide significant physical health benefits.
ex.t: 对成年人来说，志愿服务能带来显著的身体健康益处。

ex.s: It’s also our job to support adults who need help repairing incomplete life cycles.
ex.t: 支持那些需要帮助以修复不完整生命周期的成年人，也是我们的职责。

ex.s: However, psychologists have demonstrated that when adults read news stories, they remember more of the content than if they listen to or view identical pieces.
ex.t: 然而，心理学家已证明，成年人在阅读新闻故事时比听或看相同内容记住更多。

ex.s: While the adults were busy with their serious talk outside, I was left alone in the ____21____ to help my grandmother wash dishes. ____22____ my grandmother would tell me stories about her childhood.
ex.t: 当大人们在门外忙着严肃交谈时，我被单独留在____21____帮祖母洗碗。____22____祖母会给我讲她童年的故事。

ex.s: As adults we face a version of the marshmallow test every day.
ex.t: 作为成年人，我们每天都面对着棉花糖测试的变体。

ex.s: One in four adults say that TV chefs have made them much more confident about expanding their cookery knowledge and skills, and young people are also getting more interested in cooking.
ex.t: 四分之一的成年人说，电视上的厨师让他们对拓展自己的烹饪知识和技能更有信心，年轻人也对烹饪越来越感兴趣。

ex.s: Why was it difficult for ancient human adults to produce labiodentals?
ex.t: 为什么古代成年人类难以发出唇齿音？

ex.t: 那个寒冷的周一早晨，他等了很久很久，等大人（第9空）。

ex.t: “尤多拉九岁了，我允许她读书架上任何她想读的书，儿童的或成人的，”母亲说。

ex.s: Today’s world is not an easy adjustment for young adults.
ex.t: 当今世界对年轻人来说并不容易适应。

ex.t: 年轻人未来成功的关键技能

ex.t: 成年人懂得被物品淹没是什么感觉。

ex.s: Most of us observed much more as children than we do as adults.
ex.t: 我们大多数人童年时观察得比成年后多得多。

ex.t: （1）根据第2段，与成人相比，孩子更____。

ex.s: More than 23 percent of adults and 80 percent of adolescents don't get enough physical activity, and according to a 2019 report from the World Health Organization.
ex.t: 超过23%的成年人和80%的青少年缺乏足够的身体活动，根据世界卫生组织2019年的一份报告。

ex.s: Magazines and newspapers provide adults with critical news.
ex.t: 杂志和报纸为成年人提供关键新闻。

ex.s: Imagine a future where most adults own individual self-driving vehicles.
ex.t: 想象一个未来，多数成年人拥有各自的自动驾驶汽车。

ex.s: These advertise the presence of chicks to adults; they might also encourage our chick to start calling as well.
ex.t: 这些向成年蜂宣示雏鸟的存在；它们也可能鼓励我们的雏鸟开始鸣叫。

ex.s: Adults need about eight hours.
ex.t: 成年人需要约八小时。

ex.s: I would run around the house, listening to the adults chatting about their year.
ex.t: 我会在屋里跑来跑去，听大人们聊他们的一年。

ex.s: The book was an immediate success with children and adults, and has remained popular ever since.
ex.t: 这本书立即在儿童和成人中取得成功，并从此一直受欢迎。
